# stdenv `*Phase` strings run under setup.sh's `set -eu -o pipefail`.
# The phase NAMES listed in `phases` are data, not sites.
buildPhase | '' | bash errexit nounset pipefail | - | "\n    make all\n  "
installPhase | '' | bash errexit nounset pipefail | - | "\n    install -Dm755 demo $out/bin/demo\n  "
checkPhase | " | bash errexit nounset pipefail | - | "make test"
